_comment: BrowserStack App Automate device sets for the 3-stage regression plan. Device strings are '<Device Name>-<OS version>' per BrowserStack's Maestro API. VALIDATED 2026-08-02 against the live app-automate/devices.json — every entry below is confirmed available. Re-validate with scripts/browserstack/validate-device-sets.mjs after any edit; the original hand-written list had 5 entries that did not exist. Grounded in the live fleet (CLAUDE.md S34): Android 11 (40%) + 14 (33%), 3 GB+ RAM, Samsung/Xiaomi/OnePlus ~87%, nobody below Android 10.
_gaps: BrowserStack carries NO Samsung A-series devices, so the A55/A16 repro owed on #54/#168/#237 (TECH_DEBT #126) cannot be covered here — it stays an owner/field task. Galaxy S23/S24/S25 cover One UI generally.

smoke._why: Stage 1 boot gate: clean Android + One UI + MIUI, plus the newest and the smallest iPhone.

regression._why: Stage 2 full regression. Redmi Note 9 is the exact device class from the 2026-06-20 play-freeze investigation (Helio G85 / Android 10 / MIUI) — the slow-SoC class that surfaced both stacked bugs. Redmi Note 11 covers Android 11, the single largest fleet cohort (40%). iPhone 17-26 covers iOS 26, where the NativeTabs BottomAccessory mini-player and the RNS teardown crash (#160 / QARIAHV2-1G) live.

full._why: Release-candidate / quarterly sweep. Adds the Android 15-16 One UI 7 cohort (S25 Ultra, S24) implicated in the boot-hang class, an Android 11 OnePlus, and an iPad.
